item.tib: rab 'byams bder gshegs rgya mtsho'i gsol 'debs thugs rje'i sprin dpung ngo mtshar byin rlabs 'bum ldan
item.coloph: smras pa/ rgyal kun ye shes klong du ro gcig kyang / rgyal bas gang la gang 'dul der ston gyi/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor phyi nang lha tshogs la/ rgyal bstan rigs 'dres gsol 'debs smra ba po/ kun mkhyen lung rig rgya mtsho 'bod pa de'i/ kun snang rig pa'i mdangs las 'khrungs pa yi/ kun gyis gsol 'debs 'di la 'bad gyur na'ang / kun kyang las sgrib myur du 'byung bar nges/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan cha 'phra zhing / 'chad rtsom pa yi mig bu ma ldan kyang / blun pos smyo gtam 'khyal tshig smras 'di la/ 'gal bar gyur na mkhyen spyan ldan la bshags/ 'di la legs tshogs shig snying tsam mchis na/ ma rgan 'gro rnams sgrib gnyis myur byang nas/ don gnyis lhun grub bzhi'i gter la spyod/ bla med rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob par smon//
